label: lastTileWins: the painted box is the last painted tile's, not the union across tiles
windowIgnored: each tile is scanned whole, so painted pixels outside the selection widen the box
anyClearSkips: once one clear tile is seen every later tile is skipped, so paint in a later tile is missed
partialTileSkipped: a tile the placed pixels only partly cover is left clear, so the square loses its edge
find: try tiles[i].setPixel(x: px - rect.x, y: py - rect.y, buffer.pixel(x: px - x, y: py - y))
